macros.name: cistercian
macros.doc: Prints the value of the LaTeX 2ε ⟨counter⟩ as a Cistercian numeral (similar to how \roman prints a ⟨counter⟩ as a Roman numeral).

macros.name: cistercianeval
macros.doc: Evaluates the ⟨integer expression⟩ and prints the result as a Cistercian numeral.

macros.name: cisterciannum
macros.doc: Prints the ⟨integer⟩ as a Cistercian numeral.

macros.name: cistercianredrawlazy
macros.doc: The lazy variant will not immediately redraw the glyphs, but instead ensure that the next usage of a Cistercian numeral in the current scope will redraw the glyphs.

macros.name: cisterciansetup
macros.doc: Can be used to locally change the options after the package was loaded.

macros.name: cistercianstyle
macros.doc: With this macro you can define a key called ⟨name⟩ that’ll set the options in the ⟨key=value⟩ list if used inside \cisterciansetup.

macros.name: cistercianstyle*
macros.doc: With this macro you can define a key called ⟨name⟩ that’ll set the options in the ⟨key=value⟩ list if used inside \cisterciansetup.
